Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a course offered on the Edemy platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Course entity.

creatorId.description: Reference to the User who created this course. (Relationship: User 1:N Course)

description.description: A detailed description of the course content and objectives.

category.description: The category this course belongs to (e.g., Art, Design, Programming).

videoUrl.description: URL to the hosted video content for the course.

outline.description: The outline of the course, could be generated by AI or created by course creator.

status.description: The status of the course (e.g., pending, published, rejected).

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Edemy platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image.

purchasedCourseIds.description: References to Courses purchased by the user. (Relationship: User 1:N CoursePurchase)

favoriteCreatorIds.description: References to creators the user has favorited.

role.description: The role of the user (e.g., user, creator, admin).

creatorStatus.description: The verification status of a creator application.

payoutRequested.description: Indicates if a creator has a pending payout request.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Represents a purchase of a course by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Purchase entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who made the purchase. (Relationship: User 1:N Purchase)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course that was purchased. (Relationship: Course 1:N Purchase)

purchaseDate.description: The date and time when the purchase was made.

price.description: The price of the course at the time of purchase.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Represents a course recommendation for a user based on AI analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Recommendation entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User the recommendation is for. (Relationship: User 1:N Recommendation)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course being recommended. (Relationship: Course 1:N Recommendation)

reason.description: The reason for the recommendation, generated by AI.

recommendationDate.description: The date and time when the recommendation was generated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership ensures only the authenticated user can access their data. Admins have broader access.

/courses/{courseId}.description: Stores course information. Access control is based on the creatorId field, which links to the user who created the course. Admins can manage all courses.

/purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Stores purchase records for each user. This subcollection enables easy retrieval of a user's purchase history. Path-based ownership.

/users/{userId}/recommendations/{recomme.description: Stores AI-generated course recommendations for each user. This subcollection ensures that recommendations are specific to each user. Path-based ownership.
